Subject: Azure private offer: Acceptance workflow, certs needed & invoice routing

Hi Sanjay —

Thanks again for the time last week. Per our procurement conversation, attaching a short acceptance checklist and the current SOW so your finance team can map the invoice path. Two quick asks from our side to keep the Azure private offer onboarding on schedule: 

1) Can procurement confirm the PO format and whether you need Azure billing passthrough or direct Redwood invoicing? I attached "Halcyon_PO_Template.pdf" as an example the team can fill.
2) We need confirmation on SOC 2 attestation (or in-flight timeline) and the contact for any security artifacts routing to Azure Marketplace Ops.

Next steps I suggest: you confirm invoicing path + provide target PO date (we'll mirror that in the DocuSign). If it's easier, we can do a 20-min call with Laura (finance) to align.

Attachments: Redwood_SOW_v1.2.pdf (pdf), Halcyon_PO_Template.pdf (pdf)

Thanks,

mateo@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0187

From: Sanjay Patel <sanjay@halcyon.ai>

Cc: procurement@halcyon.ai
Date: Mon, 25 May 2026 18:46:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Azure private offer: Acceptance workflow, certs needed & invoice routing

Mateo —

Thanks for the SOW and template. A couple of clarifications from procurement: 

- We prefer Azure billing passthrough for marketplace private offers. Can you confirm Redwood supports that for this SKU and whether there are any timing constraints?
- SOC 2: we have the report but need a short attestation letter for the Azure listing. Do you have a standard one? If not, please advise on the deliverable and ETA.
- Revenue share / co-sell: our finance team wants the confirmed split noted in the SOW or an attachment before we issue the PO. Is that possible to lock now or do we need MS confirmation?

I can route the PO once we have the attestation and a cleared invoice routing plan. Happy to take Laura on a call tomorrow afternoon.

Sanjay Patel
Head of Procurement | Halcyon AI
sanjay@halcyon.ai

[Attachment: Halcyon_PO_Template_filled_sample.pdf (pdf) - sample PO with our fields filled]

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.ai>

Date: Tue, 26 May 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Azure private offer: Acceptance workflow, certs needed & invoice routing

Marissa / Laura —

Looping you in on Halcyon procurement. Quick asks from Sanjay: SOC2 attestation letter, confirmation of Azure billing passthrough, and an explicit revenue split callout for the SOW. Can legal & finance do the following?

- Marissa: can you draft a concise attestation (one page) referencing our SOC 2 Type II report and the Azure listing requirement? Also confirm whether we can add a revenue share appendix to this SOW that calls out the co-sell split as 'subject to Microsoft enrollment confirmation' or if legal prefers hard language.
- Laura: please confirm Redwood's operational support for Azure billing passthrough for private offers and whether invoice routing requires any special vendor IDs from Halcyon. If you prefer, we can share InvoiceRouting_Guide.xlsx.

I left Halcyon a proposed DocuSign timeline for EOD Friday so they can route PO and we can start onboarding next week.

Thanks,
Mateo

Hi Sanjay —

Thanks for the clear list. I've attached a one-page SOC2 attestation and an SOW appendix that includes a provisional co-sell revenue split (Appendix A). A few notes: 

- SOC2 attestation (attached) references our 2026 SOC2 Type II audit and is suitable for Marketplace Ops intake. If Marketplace Ops requires additional evidence, please let us know who the contact is and we'll route the artifacts.
- Revenue share language: we've included the split as 'provisional and subject to Microsoft's Marketplace enrollment/approval' — this allows Halcyon to proceed without delaying procurement while we sync with MS Ops. If you need the split confirmed prior to PO, we can ask marketplace-support to confirm but that will add ~48-72 hours.
- Billing passthrough: Laura confirms we support Azure billing passthrough and the InvoiceRouting_Guide.xlsx contains the vendor IDs and required PO fields. Laura: please confirm the exact vendor ID Halcyon should include.

Next steps: Mateo to send a DocuSign packet that includes the updated SOW + Appendix A + SOC2 attestation. Sanjay: once PO is issued referencing the DocuSign envelope, we will coordinate with Azure Marketplace Ops to finalize the private offer listing.

DocuSign link (sent by Mateo): https://www.docusign.com/nev/abc1234567890

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Counsel | Redwood Inference
